title: The first man to The Rock in five real photos
description: Michelangelo's Adam, a vice president's oath and a Pentagon gift connect the first man in the Bible to Dwayne Johnson.
hook: How is Adam connected to The Rock?

image.credit: Official White House photo by Emily Higgins

links.line: Michelangelo painted Adam on the Sistine Chapel ceiling, and at Easter 2025, JD Vance stood right beneath him.
Three months earlier, Vance took the vice president's oath while outgoing president Joe Biden looked on.
Back in 2012, Ash Carter of the Pentagon handed Vice President Biden a model armored truck.
As Defense Secretary in 2016, Carter met comedian Kevin Hart backstage at Late Night with Seth Meyers.
And in Berlin that year, Hart posed with his Central Intelligence co-star, The Rock.
